_doc: What townsfolk say about real events (docs/LIVING_WORLD.md), by rumor kind; '<kind>_you' when told to the player it is about. Placeholders: {subject} {object} {player} {detail} {place} {when}.

beat_player: They say {subject} beat a fighter called {object} {place}, {when}.
{subject} knocked {object} flat {place}. People can't stop talking about it.
I heard {object} lost to {subject} {when}. Bad luck.
beat_player_you: Word is {subject} beat you {place}. Is that true?
People say {subject} got the better of you {when}. Don't let it get you down.
lost_to_player: {object} beat {subject} {place}, {when}. That one's a real fighter.
Did you hear? {subject} lost to someone named {object}!
lost_to_player_you: Everyone's saying you beat {subject} {when}! Nicely done.
So you're the one who beat {subject}? The whole town's talking.
humiliated: {subject} got beaten and then spared {place}. Imagine the shame!
They say someone spared {subject}'s life {when}. A fighter like that won't forget it.
humiliated_you: You spared {subject}? Kind of you. Or foolish. Fighters like that come back.
survived_death: {subject} was finished off {place}, they say... and walked away anyway. Gives me chills.
People thought {subject} was dead. They were wrong.
new_form: Something big happened {place}: {subject} reached {detail}! You could feel it for miles.
{subject} has a new form, {detail}. The ground shook, they say.
tournament_win: {subject} won the tournament! Everyone's talking about it.
The champion now is {subject}. Can you believe it?
duel: Two fighters went at it {place}: {subject} beat {object}.
retreated: {subject} ran from a fight {place}. Not so tough after all.
town_attacked: Did you hear? {detail} was attacked by {subject}!
town_attacked_you: You're the one who attacked {detail}! Stay away from me!
player_famous: Have you heard of {subject}? A fighter everyone's talking about.
There's a fighter called {subject}. People say they're becoming a legend.
{subject}'s name is on everyone's lips lately.
player_famous_you: You're getting famous, you know! People talk about you all over.
Ha! Do you know your name's on everyone's lips?
strong_fighter: {subject} is making a name for themselves. A {detail}, they say.
Watch out for {subject}. Getting stronger by the day.
training_hard: {subject} has been training like a madman lately.
Have you seen {subject} at the dojo? Doesn't stop.
newcomer: We have a newcomer: {subject} just moved to {detail}.
Have you met {subject}? Just moved in.
mourning: Poor {subject}... gone. It isn't the same without them.
We lost {subject} {when}. I still can't believe it.
fell: {subject} won't be fighting anyone anymore. Gone for good.
